bug.title: Moderators cannot decide flags on discussion posts or reviews: the API refuses every non-paper decision with 422
bug.symptoms: On /mod/{postCid} (opened from a discussion-post flag) "Sign decision" with Hide or Dismiss fails: POST /v1/moderation/decisions returns 422 "The decision targets 'bafyrei...', which is not a paper version this node holds."; a review flag gives the same 422; flags stay "Waiting for a moderator" and the reporter never gets an outcome (MOD-2 flag, decision, appeal is still broken for non-paper records) The moderation item page lists authors, reporters and appellants as raw DIDs although their profile names are known
bug.reproduction_steps: As a member report a discussion post; as priya open /mod, Flags, Decide on it, choose Hide (or Dismiss), Sign decision: 422 (journey 07, screenshots/07-flag-and-dispute/s2-11-hide-decision-422.png, s2-12-dismiss-decision.png, s2-14-review-dismiss-422.png)
bug.expected: The moderation decision API accepts decisions whose target is any flaggable record the node holds (discussion post, annotation, revealed review, paper version) with actions valid for that type: dismiss (closes the flags, no content change) for every type, hide for posts/annotations/reviews (the record stays in the signed log but its body is withheld from public reads with a "hidden by moderation" placeholder and the reason, reversible on appeal), and the existing list/hold/reject/tombstone for paper versions; deciding resolves every open flag on that target, notifies each reporter and the record's author with the outcome, and is appealable like paper decisions; actions invalid for a type get 422 with a clear message. The mod console sends the right action for the record type and shows the outcome after signing; authors, reporters and appellants show as profile names (DID as secondary text) wherever a name exists
bug.actual: 422 on every non-paper decision; DIDs everywhere

constraints.constraint: Decisions remain signed records in the event log; paper-version decision behaviour and its tests are unchanged

bug.title: Report on the paper header always sends signed-in members to /signin; held paper page shows a misleading stepper and title
bug.symptoms: The paper header's Report button always navigates to /signin, even for a signed-in member, so nobody can report a paper; signed out it also drops ?next= (ReportPaper reads the token store once at render instead of following the session) "+ Follow" and "Report" touch with no gap in the paper header On a held paper the author's stepper shows "Moderation Done / Listed In progress"; the held paper's browser title reads "Paper unavailable" while the paper renders for its author
bug.reproduction_steps: Sign in as any member, open /p/{id}, click Report: lands on /signin (journey 07, screenshots/07-flag-and-dispute/s2-03-header-report-signed-in.png, s2-01-signed-out-header-report.png) As the author of a held paper open it (screenshots/11-moderation-hold-and-appeal/s2-06-sam-paper-held.png)
bug.expected: Report follows the live session (the same session hook the rest of the header uses): signed in it opens the report panel and posts the flag; signed out it goes to /signin?next={current path and hash}; header actions have consistent spacing per design.md; a held paper's stepper shows Moderation as "Held" (attention state) with Listed upcoming, and the document title is the paper title whenever the paper renders
bug.actual: Paper reports impossible; misleading held state

bug.title: Author responses render as raw field dumps in triplicate; written reports missing from the latest-version listing; review flags target the sealed commit
bug.symptoms: On /reviews/{id} (and the v1 listing and inside "Earlier revisions") each author response renders three times, two of them as bare field dumps ("Response cid / Responsecid / Cid / Id / Review cid" with CIDs) before the real text; GET /v1/papers/{id}/reviews returns the same response under responses, response and replies On the v2 listing both revealed v1 review cards say "No written report." although the reports show on /reviews/{id}/v1, and a reviewer's updated report appears nowhere publicly; report_cid is null for every review in the listing The gate text above the v2 listing says "No review has been committed on this version yet" / "1 review has been committed ... revealed once one more..." while revealed reviews are shown in full right below; the page header says "the scores and their medians are public either way" while sealed cards say "The rubric is sealed with the review" Report on a review card files the flag against the sealed review.commit record, so /mod labels it "SEALED REVIEW" with no excerpt although the review is public The report panel for a review asks "Why are you reporting the post by Reviewer A?"
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 13 on sch:asxp-nk4e-m4uy: author posts v2 with responses, okafor updates his review; open /reviews/asxp-nk4e-m4uy anonymously (screenshots/13-new-version-and-review-update/s2-10-anon-reviews-v2.png, s2-11-author-replies-raw.png, s2-15-after-update.png, s2-16-anon-reviews-after-update.png) Journey 07: report a revealed review, open /mod
bug.expected: The reviews listing API returns each author response once (one canonical field) and the tab renders it once as a formatted reply (author name, date, per-item text) under the review it answers; every revealed review in every listing carries its written report (report content or report_cid resolvable through /v1/content) and the card shows it; updated reviews show their latest report publicly with earlier ones under "Earlier revisions"; the gate text describes reviews targeting the listed version and states plainly when earlier-version reviews shown below are already revealed; header copy agrees with the sealed-card copy; Report on a revealed review targets the revealed review record so /mod can show its excerpt; the report panel says "review by Reviewer A" for reviews
bug.actual: Raw dumps, missing reports, contradictory copy, flags on the sealed record

constraints.constraint: REV-4 anonymity and the commit-reveal gate are unchanged; nothing sealed may be shown

bug.title: The weekly submission limit is still only reported at the last step; co-authors show as DIDs across submit and consent
bug.symptoms: Signed in as an author who already submitted this week, /submit says nothing on open or after reload; the limit is reported only after uploading and completing all five steps (apps/web/src/features/submit/eligibility.ts notes the API has no endpoint for the weekly window, so the up-front check never knows about it) A co-author added by DID shows only the DID (twice) on the Sign summary and tracker; the consent page shows "signed by did:key:..." and lists every author as a DID; the new-version tracker shows "You" plus a DID After signing, the disabled "Sign and submit" button stays visible above the tracker
bug.reproduction_steps: Fresh seed-demo; sign in as mei; open /submit (journey 10, screenshots/10-publish/s2-02-mei-submit-reload.png, s2-26-mei-weekly-limit-at-sign.png) As ana submit with rafael as co-author by DID (screenshots/10-publish/s2-11-sign-summary.png, s2-13-tracker-stepper.png, s2-14-consent-page.png)
bug.expected: The API exposes GET /v1/submissions/eligibility (authenticated) returning the caller's tier, whether they may submit now, the weekly quota used/allowed and the next allowed time (from the same limits code that enforces it), and their endorsed categories; /submit calls it on open and blocks the wizard before any upload with a plain-language explanation and the next allowed date in the viewer's locale; every place in submit/consent that shows a person resolves their profile name through the public profile API (GET /v1/profiles/{did}), showing the DID only as secondary text or when no name exists; once a version is signed the wizard's action bar is replaced by the tracker
bug.actual: Late refusal; DIDs instead of names

bug.symptoms: /u/{did} has no Follow control signed in or out (the previous fix edited public-profile-page.tsx, but the /u/[did] route renders profile-page.tsx) In /me Follows a followed paper shows as "sch:z7im-izv3-lom6" and links to /c/sch%3Az7im-izv3-lom6 (404) "Mark as read" updates the card but the bell count stays until reload rafael's /me lists three identical unread "Consent request" notifications for one version; each notification repeats its label ("Open / consent request / Mark as read / consent request") Guardians and recovery requests on /me/security show raw DIDs where profile names exist The header search box is empty on /search?q=...
bug.reproduction_steps: Open /u/{lena's did} signed in and out (journeys 05, 14: screenshots/05-follow-search-notify/s2-05-author-profile-no-follow.png, screenshots/14-endorse-newcomer/s2-12-anon-profile.png) Follow a paper, open /me Follows, click it (screenshots/05-follow-search-notify/s2-07-follow-paper-link.png) As mei mark a notification read (screenshots/05-follow-search-notify/s2-11-mei-marked-read.png)
bug.expected: The /u/{did} page renders the Follow/Following toggle for that person (and nothing renders a dead public-profile variant); /me Follows shows papers by title linking to /p/{id}, people by name linking to /u/{did}, categories linking to /c/{code}; marking read (single or all) updates the bell count immediately (shared notifications state or an event the nav listens to); the API does not create a second unread notification of the same kind for the same recipient and subject while one is unread (consent requests are created once per co-author per version); notification items render their label once with accessible action names; /me/security shows guardians and requesters by profile name with the DID secondary; the header search box shows the current query on /search

bug.title: Email verification links point at the API (wrong host, POST-only route); the ORCID mock always issues the same iD
bug.symptoms: The "Email verification" notification links to http://localhost:8000/v1/profiles/{did}/verify-email?... - the API host from a default setting (the API here runs on 8200), and a route that only accepts POST, so following the link can never verify the address The mock ORCID page always issues iD 0000-0002-1825-0097, so only the first account on a node can link; later newcomers get "already linked to an active DID" and the setup page then still says "You've started linking... Continue at ORCID"
bug.reproduction_steps: New member sets an email in onboarding, opens the Email verification notification: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (journey 03, screenshots/03-new-member-onboarding/s2-13-notification-open.png) Two new members link ORCID through the mock (journey 14, screenshots/14-endorse-newcomer/s2-03-after-orcid.png, s2-04)
bug.expected: Verification links point at a web page on the web origin (WEB_ORIGINS' first entry, or a WEB_PUBLIC_URL setting) such as /verify-email?did=...&token=..., which shows what is being verified and POSTs the token to the API, then confirms success or explains expiry with a resend option; the mock ORCID authorize page lets the tester accept a generated valid iD (unique per authorization, valid ISO 7064 checksum) or type one, and after a failed link the onboarding page shows the error with a retry instead of "Continue at ORCID"
bug.actual: Email can never be verified; ORCID mock usable once per node
